artifact.description: Retrieve the member_status string for a given member_id as shown in the member search results.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Member ID entered into the Member ID field.

selection_context.use_when: When you need to look up a member's Status from the member search results by providing a Member ID (the capability requires the member_id input).
selection_context.workflow_summary: Search the Members area for a given Member ID and return the Status value from the matching result row.
example_goals: What is the status of member 12345?
Find the Status for member ID 12345
Show me the Status for member 98765
Lookup member 12345 and return their status
Retrieve the Status field for member ID 55555
